#7 Mead Hall

At the center of dwarvish life stands the Mead Hall--a place of warmth and fire where bonds are forged stronger than iron. Here, beneath carved timbers and roaring hearths, tankards clash, stories swell, and the breath of community fills the air. It is a house of revelry, of counsel, of ritual and remembrance. With spaces carved for feasting, governance, and tale-weaving alike, the hall reflects the dwarven spirit: stout, spirited, and unyieldingly communal.
